title: Choose the visual world for the LLM Credit Risk Lab showcase
question: The roll assigned The Credit Committee File. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Credit Committee File
options.lineage: bank credit-committee loan files: tabbed dossier, memo header, rubber-stamped decision
options.thesis: The study is brought before a credit committee, and every feature set gets a stamped decision.
materials: frosted vellum sheets (the brief's glass, translated)
options.viewport: Dark committee table; a vellum cover sheet states the question over a live field of 125,700 loan motes; the headline result carries a stamp: NOT PROVEN, p = 0.079; primary action opens the file.
options.risk: Stamps and tabs turn into costume the moment they stop carrying real verdicts.

raised.raise: The hero field is real data: one seeded mote per loan, colored by outcome, drifting under the cursor.
Test-set numbers develop once, after the method is read; only the stamped verdict appears above the fold.
Numbers snap digit by digit, never glide; the unfinished E2/E3 file shows a visibly incomplete stamp.
Every number carries its provenance seam: the metrics.json path it came from.
One ground, hierarchy by light only: vellum brightness, never a second arbitrary dark.

options.label: The Validation Dossier
options.lineage: independent model-validation reports (SR 11-7 style): exhibits, findings, effective challenge
options.thesis: The study as an independent validation report: numbered exhibits, severity-rated findings, challenge.
options.viewport: Exhibit 1 fills the hero: the paired-bootstrap interval for E1 minus E0 against zero, with its finding beside it.
options.risk: The most familiar reading for this audience, and where most runs land; can read like a PDF.

options.label: Console Void
options.thesis: Experiments as monoliths in fog, loans as drifting motes, the chosen one glowing amber.
options.viewport: A dark room of five glowing towers, E0 to E4, one swelling forward.
options.risk: Reads as game nostalgia to a bank risk team.
options.case: Fuses well technically but loses on audience identification and on reading the numbers.
options.kept: Its real-data particle field became the hero of the assigned file.

options.label: Darkroom Safelight
options.thesis: Results develop under amber safelight; pulling a print early is a real loss.
options.viewport: A developing tray where the Gini value emerges from gray.
options.risk: Amber monochrome makes interval charts hard to read.
options.case: The 'test set is touched once' idea is strong, but bankers do not live in darkrooms.
options.kept: Test numbers develop once, after the method.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.lineage: bus destination blinds, dyed duck cloth
options.thesis: Results as cloth courses stepping under one window; a fault stops mid-step.
options.viewport: One window showing the current experiment's legend on green cloth.
options.risk: A drenched green monitoring board fights the dark cinematic brief.
options.case: An Operate grammar on a Persuade page; loses both axes.
options.kept: Numbers snap, never glide; unfinished work shows as a visible seam.

options.label: Memory Quilt Atlas
options.thesis: Each finding a patch with its owner, date, and provenance stitched on.
options.viewport: A quilt of unequal patches, one per experiment.
options.risk: Domestic warmth undercuts a model-risk audience.

options.label: Mezzotint Velvet Night
options.thesis: Signal emerges by burnishing light out of total black.
options.viewport: A black plate with the question scraped into light.
options.risk: Beautiful but abstract; the numbers lose their frame.
options.kept: One ground; hierarchy by light only.

options.label: Gravity-Rain Garden
options.thesis: Colored rains obey local gravities across a dusk garden.
options.viewport: Rain falling toward five flowers, one per experiment.
options.risk: Whimsy contradicts the measured, audit-grade positioning.
options.kept: Deterministic replay: the particle field is seeded like the experiments.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The brief's own example played straight: obsidian ground, platinum text, one emerald accent, glass bento.
canonCard.viewport: Huge value proposition over a morphing glass orb, one glowing CTA.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every AI-startup landing page.
